description.narrative:
General Objective: Project Impact Contribute to the reduction of greenhouse gases and preservation of ecosystems in the waste subsector through the development of management models with a circular economy approach.
Specific objective: project purpose Consolidate and replicate solid waste management models, approaches and tools in a major city and an intermediate city by leveraging resources and articulating public initiatives (national and local), as well as private initiatives.
Results framework For the second phase, a support component for national policies is proposed, with the objective of scaling up the lessons learned from the project to national public policies (Outcome 1); a second component dedicated to the new municipalities of intervention (Outcome 2) and finally a component dedicated to knowledge management focused on the consolidation of actions in the municipalities of intervention of the first phase and the systematization of experiences of the second phase, in order to capitalize and systematize the good practices and lessons learned (Outcome 3).

Den nya insatsen syftar till att bidra till minskade växthusgaser inom avfallssektorn genom att främja hanteringsmodeller under en cirkulär ekonomi. Huvudmålet är inriktat på att konsolidera och replikera modeller för hantering av fast avfall, metoder och verktyg i en mellanstor stad genom att utnyttja resurser och artikulera offentliga (nationella och lokala) såväl som privata initiativ.

The new intervention wants to contribute to the reduction of greenhouse gases in the waste subsector through the promotion of management models under a circular economy approach. The main objective is oriented to consolidate and replicate solid waste management models, approaches and tools in a major an intermediate city by leveraging resources and articulating public initiatives (national and local), as well as private initiatives.

description.narrative:
The main results per outcome during the 2023 period are as follow: Outcome 1: Head of sector has strategic instruments - Waste national diagnostic elaborated and edited for its publication. - Design and implementation of a tool for GHG calculation for sector investment projects - Municipal sectoral demand assessment tool in Solid Waste Management elaborated in a first version and in testing phase with the municipalities of the first phase of the project.
Outcome 2: municipalities implement circular models - Diagnostic of waste management in Oruro´s municipality. - Pilot of differentiated collection of organics in markets. It started with a pilot composting plant in Huajara that is receiving 18 tons of organics per week. Currently, the project is monitoring parameters to subsequently develop a manual for composting in high altitude conditions that it is expected will becomea national norm (in coordination with MMAyA) - Norms and Procedures on integral waste management developed and approved by the Municipality of Oruro. - Evaluation study of the sanitation fee for waste management service´s sustainability in Oruro. The results have been presented to EMAO's Board of Directors and a strategy has been developed to increase the fees during the next period. - Business plans for private initiatives that will work under a circular economy approach in the sector have been elaborated. Private enterprises called ECOYAKU, Acogel, Los Ángeles and Manager are participating in the project. - Proposal document for intervention in rainwater channels for the reduction of pollution in Lake Uru Uru. - Baseline survey for a Behavior change diagnosis to promote separation at home have been done. A behavior change strategy, including a social mobilization plan for the separation of organic waste at source have been included.
Outcome 3: Model consolidation Regarding municipal waste management, during 2023, 3,659.5 tons of organic and inorganic waste have been treated, equivalent to an increase of 188% over the data reported at the end of Phase I. In Tarija, actions have been taken to close the Pampa Galana landfill to optimize leachate management and prevent overflows. Differentiated collection has been extended to 4 new neighborhoods. Technical assistance has been provided to the Environmental Secretariat of the Autonomous Municipal Government of Tarija for the development of the Pre Investment Study "EDTP" which led to the closure of the Pampa Galana landfill and the start of work on the new Solid Waste Treatment Complex.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
